symptom: The current first-pass backend image fails TypeScript compilation at the passport-jwt import; Compose therefore cannot start the current backend source.
evidence: Docker backend build exited 1 with TS7016 at src/modules/auth/jwt.strategy.ts:4.
The frontend current-source production image built successfully when isolated.
Existing healthy service containers predate source revision sha256:f0fd0965a7fcb07de003b5d7f7acc755e745d8f9499fb76513726a8134ca77a4 and are not runtime evidence for this run.

root_cause.summary: The installed passport-jwt package has no declaration available to this TypeScript project, and the first-pass source does not supply one.

actions_attempted: Built the frontend image separately to isolate its result.
Ran backend and frontend lint in disposable Node containers without mutating the workspace.
After researcher authorization, added @types/passport-jwt as a backend development dependency and rebuilt only the backend image.
resolution_evidence: Current-source backend Compose image build exited 0 after npm ci, nest build and production dependency pruning completed.
reusable_resolution: Add @types/passport-jwt as a backend development dependency, update the lockfile and rebuild the backend image.
prevention: Require the authentication module production build to pass before runtime activation while preserving first-pass evidence.
